post_meta.title: Mono Pass still white
post_meta.text: Mono out of Rock Creek 6/8. Continuous snow from Ruby Lake, firm and pleasant at 6am, sloppy by 9. No steep sections, spikes are plenty. Rock Creek is loud under the snow bridges, be smart about where you stand.

post_meta.title: Mono Pass (Rock Creek) with kids
